steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What might be different about the back of the sprite, compared to the front of it?


Solution:

A spriteBackward image asset should be created by duplicating the spriteForward image asset. The tools in the paint editor should be used so that the back of the head is visible on the image.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ What tool can be used to flip an image asset in a different direction?


Solution:

The flip horizontal tool can be used to create a left facing version of the spriteLeft image asset.


Ask the ninja: 

 Which image assets should be used in the controller events to correctly change the sprite’s image?


Solution:

The sprite’s image should be set to the spriteLeft image asset when the left button is pressed. The sprite’s image should be set to the spriteBackward image asset when the up button is pressed.
steps.instructions:
Use the paint editor to modify original pixel art images to use in the project!


4 different image assets should be used to show the sprite facing in different directions.


When the direction buttons are pressed, the sprite’s image should be updated, based on the direction it’s facing.


Use the tools in the paint editor to modify each image asset!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 6 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about creating images that show multiple perspectives of the same sprite and themed sprite packs for projects. You’ll be able to take the strategies you learn in this level to create detailed assets in future projects! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 6:

badges.title: Package Deal
badges.description: Create a sprite pack that includes different sprite kinds and different perspectives of those sprites, to be used in a project.

badges.title: Covering All My Bases
badges.description: Create pixel art images that show multiple points of view for a sprite: forward, backward, left, and right.

badges.title: Group by Theme
badges.description: Use a specific color palette and theme to create a sprite pack of different sprite kinds.

badges.title: The Gang’s All Here!
badges.description: Create a sprite pack of original pixel art images that includes Player, Collectible, Goal, Enemy, and Projectile sprites.
